notes.title: The Random Flux Update
notes.notes: [p]The chaos never stops in Ominoflux! 🎉[/p][p]The [b]Random Flux Update[/b] is here, mixing together tweaks, upgrades, and brand-new add-ons in true flux fashion. Here are the details:[/p][p][/p][p][b]✨ UI & Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved campaign mode HUD, transitions and readability[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaner icons and sharper pixel text[/p][/*][*][p]Added more details to world map[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]⚙️ Gameplay Tweaks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted game play balance[/p][/*][*][p]Added a secret ultra hard quest in campaign mode[/p][/*][*][p]Quality-of-life changes for smoother runs[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked dialogue to sharpen storytelling[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded in-game text and descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]Polished up on the writing everywhere[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🆕 Add-ons & Extras[/b][/p][list][*][p]New secret level added[/p][/*][*][p]4 new levels, 3 new monster types[/p][/*][*][p]Other small surprises to keep things fresh[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🔧 General Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimized loading performance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor bugs & glitches[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This game will continue to evolve. Ominoflux is a passion project, and I’ll keep supporting and expanding it indefinitely. If you do pick it up, know that more updates and surprises are always on the way.[/p][p]Flux be with you![/p]
